commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Flag goes up against Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+1' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Luiz Junior makes a comfortable save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alberto Moleiro and he is replaced by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal).
83' Substitution. Tajon Buchanan walks off the pitch and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
82' Urko Gonzalez will be replaced by Miguel Rubio (Espanyol).
82' A substitution has been made. Omar El Hilali is replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
81' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Hernandez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
81' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
79' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Villarreal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

77' That didn't go as planned! Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Luiz Junior, who easily kept it out.
75' Espanyol force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

71' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Charles Pickel (Espanyol) replaces Pere Milla.
71' Here's the change. Exposito leaves the pitch and Jofre (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.

70' What a chance that is! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

67' Free kick. Espanyol will probably just try to cross the ball in from here. The game is interrupted. Pau Navarro (Villarreal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
65' Now Espanyol have a corner.
61' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
60' The substitution has been made. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) has replaced Pol Lozano.
57' 0 - 2 Goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:2.
57' A tremendous drive by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a brilliant save.
56' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) is caught offside!
53' Jose Salinas (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Villarreal have a free kick.

50' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Hernandez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
50' Neat passing move from Espanyol in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Pere Milla (Espanyol) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal). Espanyol are awarded the free kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.

42' A precise low pass is received by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
41' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

40' The most active player in today's match is definitely Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
36' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) serves up a nice cross, but Luiz Junior punches the ball away.
33' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) will take a corner kick.
31' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
27' Exposito (Espanyol) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Luiz Junior acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save! Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
20' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

18' Exposito (Espanyol) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
18' Dangerous play by Exposito (Espanyol). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal earn a free kick.

16' Espanyol slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
12' Pere Milla (Espanyol) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

10' A long pass finds Pere Milla (Espanyol) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
9' 47:53 – the latest ball possession ratio.

2' Espanyol keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
